scope: Use existing cached build2 full-image confidence0.25/IoU0.45 detections from already-seen v1/v2 images. No new detector inference, crop/rescale, weight, confidence, NMS, or frozen-label changes. These are development diagnostics, not blind holdout evidence.
fallback: Original input<6 -> sparse with every original detection retained. No reliable post-filter support or any empty/sparse post-filter result -> return all original detections and no exclusions. No reliable non-text anchor group -> OCR cannot delete. Empty only means originally empty input.
requiredChecks: TP/FP/FN and exact visible-count errors per image for all3 candidates
Explicit preservation of both tall Pospal endpoints
Text false-positive suppression must not delete known endpoint faces
Report uncertain/fallback cases, no concealed low-recall zero counts
selection: No additional parameter search in this development pass. Root reviews the fixed candidates; a future new v3 set must be frozen and evaluated once after selection.
ocrResults: Reuse the fixed v1 OCR boxes/settings; no additional core detector or OCR inference in this revision.
